skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 120% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 24% ATK to all enemies. Grants this unit's row +200% ATK-based [DMG Amplification], dispelling their positive effects.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 24% > 30% ATK to all enemies. [DMG Amplification] target expands from this unit's row to all allies.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains +20% HP. On entry, applies 30% [Weaken] to up to 6 enemy heroes for 1 round. From round 2 onward, at round start gains 35% [Charge DMG Reduction].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Weaken] target expands to all enemies. [Charge DMG Reduction] 35% > 45%.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Weaken] 30% > 40%, duration 1 > 2 rounds. [Charge DMG Reduction] 45% > 50% and now applies from round 1 instead of round 2.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: (Basic Effect) (1 Grappler, 2 Esper): Gains 3 energy per round.(Advance Effect) (2 Grappler, 2 Esper): When any ally takes fatal damage, they enter [Specialized Unyielding] — disappears after actions of any 4 characters, recovers 100% Max HP, triggers twice per character every battle. [Specialized Unyielding]: Take no damage, replaces [Unyielding] and is unaffected by Ignore Unyielding effects.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Additionally gains 1 energy once per round when any support character launches Follow-up.

skills.name: Awaken 3 Passive
skills.desc: When this character acts, grants the whole team 150 [Energy Gauge].

effects.desc: Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
